about_the_game:
A set of content from the "Digital Deluxe Edition":
・ Outfits by illustrator Yom (6 total)
Special costumes designed by illustrator Yom.

・ A set of episodes in collaboration with illustrator Yom
Players will be able to fully enjoy the story in special situations with the costumes designed by Yom.
・ Photograph feature "Time-Stopping Hourglass" (early unlock)
The "Time-Stopping Hourglass," which can normally be used after reaching a certain point in the game, will be unlocked early.
・ Photograph feature "Photo Frames" (6 types)
These are frames that can be used while taking photographs in the game.

Note:
- This product includes content from "Venus Vacation PRISM - DEAD OR ALIVE Xtreme - Digital Deluxe Edition." Please be careful not to make duplicate purchases.
- Please be aware that if you purchase content for the main game "Venus Vacation PRISM - DEAD OR ALIVE Xtreme -" before purchasing "Venus Vacation PRISM - DEAD OR ALIVE Xtreme - Digital Deluxe Upgrade," then the "Time-Stopping Hourglass" may already be unlocked when you purchase this product.
- The pre-order bonus and early purchase bonus are not included in the "Digital Deluxe Upgrade" version.
